name: Av-Gad Holdings Ltd
summary: Av-Gad Holdings Ltd. engages in real estate entrepreneurship. It operates through the following segments: Residential Entrepreneurship, Construction Works, and Other. The Residential Entrepreneurship segment initiates projects in Israel for apartments intended for sale, as part of urban renewal. The Construction Works segment deals with execution of residential construction works. The Other segment includes management agreements between the company and the group companies, and charges management fees for management services and office services. The company was founded on January 24, 2008 and is headquartered in Raanana, Israel.
